author: reactive-end
summary:
Memory recall fixed:
- mem_search joins terms with OR after dropping English and Spanish stopwords, so BM25 ranks fuller matches first and natural queries no longer return 0 hits.
- session_context takes the newest record of each kind in turn (domain, decision, gotcha, session), so rules and follow-ups reach mem_context and SessionStart.
- An MCP test now asserts that the teammate chunk ranks first, instead of an exact count that relied on AND semantics.
- Verified by 3 new recall tests and an isolated-agent CLI retest: context answered 6 of 7 questions and a full-sentence query hit first.
evidence: recall_tests 3/3 (fail on old code); 468 workspace tests; clippy -D warnings, fmt, anvil check PASS; isolated subagent retest via anvil mem CLI
